items.q: How do I buy a property listed on this website?
items.a: Open the listing, then book an inspection or request property details. Pablo Homes will contact you to confirm the next steps. We recommend reviewing all documents with your own lawyer before making any payment.

items.q: Can I see the property documents before paying?
items.a: Yes — ask for the available documents when you enquire about a property, and have them reviewed by a lawyer you appoint. Read our guide to property documents in Nigeria for an overview.

items.q: Are the prices on the website negotiable?
items.a: Prices are set by the property owner or developer. Ask Pablo Homes about any listing and we will tell you what we know about the price and terms.

items.q: What will I pay when I rent a property?
items.a: The total depends on the property. Ask for a full breakdown — rent, any service charge and any other fees — before you commit, and confirm which amounts are refundable.

items.q: What should I check before buying land?
items.a: Confirm who is selling, review the title documents and survey plan, inspect the land in person and use a lawyer. Our land-buying checklist covers each step.

items.q: How big is a plot in Benin City?
items.a: A plot is commonly described as about 100 × 100 feet, but sizes vary. Each listing states the land size where available — always confirm it on the survey plan.

items.q: How do I book an inspection?
items.a: Use the Book an Inspection button on any listing, or the inspection form, and choose a preferred date and time. Your booking is a request until Pablo Homes confirms the appointment with you.

items.q: Can I inspect a property by video?
items.a: Ask when you book. Where possible, a live video walkthrough can help if you cannot attend in person.

items.q: Can I buy property in Benin City while living abroad?
items.a: Yes. Many buyers do. Request details and video for the properties you are interested in, appoint a lawyer in Nigeria to act for you, and consider sending a trusted representative to inspect.

items.q: What is the best way to contact Pablo Homes from abroad?
items.a: WhatsApp is usually the easiest. You can also email or use the contact form, and Pablo Homes will reply as soon as possible.
